[{"insert":"Interval Weight Training

This interval piece uses simple, low skill moves so you can pour in real effort each set. Aim to push the pace on the row a little harder every round. The kettlebell swings and box jumps are easy to repeat when tired, which is exactly why they let you work hard. Rest the full 90 seconds between sets so each round stays fast.
"}]
